entries.en:
Hortefense asks you to help his man in La Noscea, who has been inundated with requests to deliver gifts to missing beaus. The nobleman bids you travel to Limsa Lominsa to meet with his assistant by the Aftcastle. This emissary will introduce you to one of his careworn clients, so that she might relate to you any clues she has to the location of her lost love.

※Please note that you will be unable to complete this quest after the seasonal event has ended. For details, please check the Lodestone.

You speak with the  maiden, who explains how her wagon-pulling beloved has gone out to find work, and cannot be traced. She has prepared a batch of his favorite confection─an especially minty chocolate─that must be delivered to him before Valentione's Day is out. However, she has but one clue as to his location: the  she recalls him speaking of before he departed. She begs you to search for her missing sweetheart and deliver her gift to him.

※Please note that the wagoner you seek will not be marked on the map, nor will any identifying symbol appear above the character's head. Share your information with other players, and try to find him.

entries.fr: Au fait, quand vous verrez sire Hortefense, pourriez-vous lui faire savoir que nous n'avons pas trouvé de jeune femme qui correspond à la description qu'il nous a donnée à Limsa Lominsa ?
entries.ja:
そうだ、この後でオルトファンス殿へ報告すると思うが、
その際に「お探しの女性はいまだ見つからず」と、
伝えてくれないか？

entries.en: And honestly, how could he hope for me to find her? He knows not the lady's name, nor her face, only something of her “spirit”... While he may be disappointed by the information─or lack thereof─I doubt he will find it unexpected.
entries.fr: Il faut dire aussi que sans connaître son nom ni son visage, c'est peine perdue. Si seulement nous avions un peu plus de temps je ne dis pas, mais là...
entries.ja:
探し人の名前もわからず、顔もおぼろげ、
覚えているのは雰囲気ぐらいとなると……
一朝一夕には見つからんのは、ご理解いただけるだろう。

entries.en: But your other news he will find most welcome indeed: that thanks to you, Limsa Lominsa basks in the warmth of reciprocated passion! Our house is forever in your debt, , and we shall not forget it.

entries.fr: Quoi qu'il en soit, je vous remercie une fois de plus pour l'aide précieuse que vous m'avez apportée ! J'espère que nous aurons à nouveau l'occasion de collaborer un jour, peut-être à l'occasion d'une prochaine Valention, qui sait ?
entries.ja:
さて、今回は冒険者殿のおかげで丸く収まった。
ありがとう、いくら感謝しても感謝しきれんな。
この恩は、いつかどこかで返させてくれ！
